full_judgment: 3. The plaintiff Opposite Parties filed the suit for declaration of title to the suit land on the allegations inter alia that the suit land was the khan land of the defendant No. 1 Hemendra Nath Sanyal and the defendant No. 2 Dwijendra Nath Sanyal. The plaintiff No. 1 took pattan of 2.00 acres of land from the said defendants at a rental of Rs. 15/-on 12th Falgoon, 1352 B.S. Plaintiff Nos. 1 and 2 took pattan of another 2.00 acres of land from the said defendants on the same date at a rental of Rs. 15/-. However in the C.S. Khatian only 3.47 acres of land were recorded against the suit plot and the rest. 59 acres of land were tenanted land. The plaintiff no. 1 has been possessing 2.47 acres of land from the south eastern portion of the suit plot and the plaintiff No. 2 has been possessing 1.00 acres of land from the north western portion of the suit plot, though the two plaintiffs took pattan of 4.00 acres of land in total. The suit land has wrongly been recorded in the name of the defendant No. 1 although the defendants have no title and possession in the suit land. The plaintiff filed 2 Miscellaneous Cases for correction of record of rights of the suit land but they withdrew the said Miscellaneous Cases subsequently. The Tahsilder of the defendant No. 3 refused to receive rents from the plaintiffs on 14-11-75. Hence the suit.
